title: Kapy Notes - Memo & Calculator
shortDescription: Notepad with a live calculator on every line. Budgets, units, currency, lists.
fullDescription:
Kapy Notes is a fast, private notepad with a live calculator built into every line.

Write a thought, type a calculation, and the answer appears right beside it. There is no mode to switch, no formula to set up, and no separate calculator to open.

WRITE THE WAY YOU THINK
• Notes, checklists, journals, meeting notes, and everyday scratch work
• Budgets, splits, percentages, estimates, and running totals
• Currency, length, weight, volume, temperature, and time conversions
• Markdown-style headings, emphasis, lists, links, images, videos, and voice notes
• Search, archive, protected hidden notes, export, and import

CALCULATIONS THAT READ LIKE SENTENCES
• 1250 + 8% for tax or a tip
• 120 EUR to USD at refreshed exchange rates
• 350 g to oz while scaling a recipe
• 180 C to F
• 100 km / 2 h

VOICE NOTES YOUR WAY
Record without an account. Choose local transcription to keep audio on your device, or sign in and deliberately enable cloud transcription. Local transcription and local summaries are unlimited. Cloud usage is shown clearly in Settings.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Notes stay on your device unless you turn on sync
• Sync is end-to-end encrypted; we cannot read your notes
• Shared notes are encrypted for the people you invite
• Block and report controls are built into sharing
• No ads, advertising identifiers, or cross-app tracking
• Close your account from inside the app whenever you like
• Works offline for notes and calculations

FOREVER FREE
Use every writing and calculation tool with up to five editable notes, 100 MB of storage, 15 minutes of cloud transcription each month, and 100 cloud summaries or rewrites each month. On-device transcription and summaries do not use those allowances. If you reach a limit, nothing is deleted and extra notes remain readable and exportable.

PRO LIFETIME
Every account begins with a 14-day Pro trial. No card is required and nothing renews. Pro Lifetime is one purchase, not a subscription. It unlocks unlimited notes, encrypted sync and sharing, 1 GB of storage, 120 cloud transcription minutes each month, and 1,000 cloud summaries or rewrites each month. Pro members can optionally buy repeatable 5 GB storage and 1,000-minute transcription packs through Google Play.

Exchange rates are supplied by Frankfurter, with ExchangeRate-API as a fallback.
releaseNotes: Attach any file to a note and keep it encrypted and in sync. Turn a new note into a drawing with pens, shapes, arrows, and text. The notes list now splits into My Notes and Shared with Me, with invitations waiting under search. Table editing is steadier, the calculator reads values that carry words after a name, empty new notes tidy themselves away, and sync stays in step on unsteady connections.
